description: Consommations d'électricité des bâtiments de la ville de Grenoble 2012-2022 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Grenoble. This dataset includes the electricity consumption of buildings in the city of Grenoble since 2012, by year. Coverage: Ville de Grenoble. The portal shows the English title as "Electricity consumption of buildings in the city of Grenoble 2012-2022" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Grenoble. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
